businessName: Cafe Buddy’s Espresso :- Best Cafe In Patna
whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Cafe Buddy’s Espresso,

I noticed your cafe has fantastic 4.6★ reviews across 300+ check-ins on Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, special menu showcase, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/cafebuddys

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Cafe Buddy’s Espresso team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? [If checked]: We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking and a mobile menu showcase for your Boring Road location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? [If not checked]: No problem at all! Direct live link aapke WhatsApp par hai. Whenever you get 2 minutes ek baar open karke check kariyega—koi commitment nahi hai, just wanted to share the idea and get your feedback. Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein!
